Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The study contains two distinct proteomics workflows: 1) AP-MS for interactomics (which uses purified protein/complex scope) and 2) Global proteome, acetylome, and phosphorylome analysis. Per the PRIDE metadata and the 'Proteome, acetylome and phosphorylome analysis' section, the primary quantitative MS experiment used whole cell lysates (urea lysis/acetone precipitation) for TMT labeling. Because the global proteome/PTM analysis is the central quantitative focus of the PRIDE project PXD040339, 'whole cell lysate' is selected as the primary scope, though AP-MS was used for the interactome discovery.
